notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Aettir and Priwen, causing you to gain life equal to Aettir and Priwen's toughness.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

uses.name: Aettir and Priwen
uses.cardState: attached to a creature you control except Enduring Tenacity
